claims.evidence: Computed from CSV: Jan new share = 33583/55983 = 0.5999 (60%); Jun new share = 25863/56427 = 0.4583 (46%). Returning share Jun = 30564/56427 = 0.5417 (54%). Matches exactly.

eval_feedback.overall: Exceptional execution across all 10 assertions -- a reference-quality output. The notebook (24 cells: 12 markdown narrative + 12 code) follows a clean Frame -> Explore -> Validate -> Story -> Charts -> Deliver arc. Every numeric claim cross-checked against funnel_monthly.csv matched the ground truth to 2 decimal places (aggregate 8.67% -> 8.76%, new 5.24% -> 7.37%, returning 13.81% -> 9.93%, mix 60/40 -> 46/54). The pattern is named both as 'Simpson\'s Paradox' (headline + code comments + validation step) and as a 'composition shift' in multiple places. Chart titles are uniformly action-oriented (insight-first), not descriptive -- exceeds the >=2 bar by a wide margin with all 7 being action-oriented. Recommendations are structured as a table with explicit owners, success metrics, and High/Medium confidence grades, plus a written rationale for each grade. The supporting paper-trail (framing.md, findings.json, validation.md, storyboard.md) is extensive and consistent with the notebook. Assertions as written are appropriate for evaluating this deliverable; no changes recommended.
